blocks.title: 💬 SAY IT WITH TACT
blocks.intro: En una reunión, la clave es ser claro pero educado. Aquí tienes las 4 movidas básicas (B1) y sus versiones ⭐ B2.

cells.body: I think… · In my opinion… · I feel that… · It seems to me that…
I agree. · Good point. · That's true. · Exactly. · That makes sense.
I see your point, but… · I'm not sure I agree. · Maybe, but have we considered…?
Why don't we…? · We could… · How about + -ing? · Maybe we should…

parts.body: Opinar: From where I stand… / As far as I'm concerned…  ·  Acordar: I'm inclined to agree. / You make a valid point.  ·  Discrepar: I see where you're coming from, but I have a slightly different perspective.  ·  Sugerir: Would it be worth considering…? / It might be beneficial to…

blocks.stage: ① MEETING LANGUAGE · opinar · acordar · discrepar · sugerir

blocks.title: 📘 MODAL VERBS · sonar profesional
blocks.intro: Los modales hacen que pedidos y opiniones suenen educados y precisos. Core (B1) en negrita; ⭐ = B2.

cells.body:
should · ⭐ ought to · ⭐ had better
"We should prioritize feedback."

could · ⭐ might · ⭐ may
"We could explore new suppliers."

must · have to · need to
"We must meet the deadline."

must not · can't · ⭐ may not
"Staff must not share this."

parts.body: Truco: "You need to finish this today." (directo) → "You should complete this by the end of the day." (profesional).

blocks.title: ★ SALES ARE DOWN
blocks.intro: El equipo se reúne porque las ventas bajaron. Practica opinar/acordar/discrepar/sugerir, y luego escucha la reunión y su resumen.
blocks.stage: ② THE STORY · la reunión de ventas

blocks.title: WHAT IS IT?

items.q: "In my opinion, we should focus on our customers."
"Absolutely — I couldn't agree more with that."
"I see your point, but I'm not entirely convinced."
"How about offering a discount for referrals?"
"From where I stand, quality should come first."

speaking.prompt: "Your company wants to increase employee satisfaction." Give an opinion, a suggestion, and agree or disagree.
speaking.starter: In my opinion, we should ask the team what they want. We could start with flexible hours…

blocks.stage: ③ PRACTICE · elige la respuesta

blocks.title: CHOOSE THE MODAL
blocks.intro: Elige el modal correcto para que suene profesional.

items.q: We ___ meet the deadline to keep the client's trust. (obligación)
Employees ___ share confidential information. (prohibición)
We ___ explore new suppliers to cut costs. (posibilidad)
You ___ request more resources if you need them. (permiso)

options: You should complete this by the end of the day.

blocks.title: AUDIO 1 · THE TEAM MEETING
blocks.desc: El equipo discute qué hacer con las ventas. Fíjate en las opiniones y sugerencias.

options: A loyalty program for existing customers
A referral discount for new customers
A price cut for the whole product line

questions.q: Does Diego fully agree with Maria?
options: Yes — he agrees with the loyalty program completely
No — he politely disagrees; he wants new customers too
No — he rejects the idea and proposes another one

questions.q: What do they decide to do first?
options: Launch the loyalty program and the referral discount now
Cancel the loyalty program and cut prices instead
Test the referral discount for one month, with a budget

speaking.prompt: Do you agree with Maria or Diego? Say why, and add one suggestion.

transcript.html: Sales are down this quarter. What do you think we should do?
In my opinion, we should focus on our existing customers. We could start a loyalty program.
I see your point, but I'm not sure that's enough. I think we need new customers too.
That's a fair point. Maybe we could do both.
Good idea. How about a small discount for referrals?
I like that. It might be beneficial to test it for one month first.
Agreed. We must set a clear budget, though.
Definitely. We shouldn't spend more than we can afford.

blocks.stage: ④ LISTENING · escucha la reunión

blocks.title: AUDIO 2 · THE RECAP
blocks.desc: Un resumen de las decisiones de la reunión. Fíjate en los acuerdos y los próximos pasos.

questions.q: How many things did they agree on?
What must they do before they start?
options: Hire an outside consultant to run the program
Set a clear budget (send the numbers by Friday)
Raise the prices before launching the discount

questions.q: When will they review the results?

transcript.html: Hi team, a quick recap of today's meeting. We agreed on two things. First, we will launch a loyalty program for our current customers. Second, we will test a referral discount for one month. We must set a clear budget before we start, so please send me your numbers by Friday. I think this is a strong plan, but we should review the results in four weeks. Thanks for a great discussion. Talk soon!

blocks.title: ✍️ MEETING SUMMARY EMAIL
blocks.intro: Escribe un email corto (4–5 oraciones) resumiendo las decisiones de una reunión. Usa:
checklist: Al menos 2 frases de opinión (In my opinion… / I think…)
Al menos 1 verbo modal (should / must / could / need to)
blocks.placeholder: Hi team, thanks for the meeting. In my opinion...
blocks.example: Hi team, thanks for the meeting today. In my opinion, ___ was our best idea. I think we should ___, and we must ___ before we start. As a next step, ___. Please ___ by ___. Thanks!
blocks.hw: Escribe tu email-resumen y (opcional) escucha 2–3 min de una reunión real (podcast/YouTube) y anota 3 frases útiles. Envíamelo por WhatsApp.
blocks.stage: ⑤ WRITING · en clase o tarea (HW)
